new_facts.label: Bariatric surgery procedure type
new_facts.ask: What specific bariatric surgery procedure is being requested (e.g., RYGBP, BPD/DS, LAGB, sleeve gastrectomy, open vs laparoscopic)?

not_modeled.quote: these procedures are only covered when performed at facilities that are: (1) certified by the American College of Surgeons as a Level 1 Bariatric Surgery Center ... or (2) certified by the American Society for Bariatric Surgery as a Bariatric Surgery Center of Excellence
not_modeled.why: This facility certification requirement was in effect only for dates of service prior to September 24, 2013 and was removed thereafter; it requires a facility-certification fact not in the vocabulary and is time-period dependent, better handled as a business rule outside this per-patient checklist.

not_modeled.quote: Open adjustable gastric banding; Open sleeve gastrectomy; Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (prior to June 27, 2012); Open and laparoscopic vertical banded gastroplasty; Intestinal bypass surgery; and, Gastric balloon for treatment of obesity.
not_modeled.why: These are blanket non-covered procedure types based on procedure selection alone, not a testable clinical fact about the patient; best handled as a procedure-code exclusion list rather than a clinical criterion.

not_modeled.quote: supplemented fasting with adequate monitoring of the patient is eligible for coverage on a case-by-case basis or pursuant to a local coverage determination
not_modeled.why: This is a discretionary, case-by-case local coverage pathway for supplemented fasting (not bariatric surgery) requiring clinical judgment on weight-loss necessity before surgery and lack of more conservative alternatives; not reducible to a simple fact test.

not_modeled.quote: CMS determines that Type 2 diabetes mellitus is a co-morbidity for purposes of this NCD.
not_modeled.why: This is informational guidance clarifying that Type 2 diabetes counts as a qualifying co-morbidity; it is already captured by the general comorbidity-present criterion and does not add a separate testable condition.
